data.reports:
# Rotifer Protocol > 为 DSH 提供 Rotifer 技能及 MCP 接入，辅助发现、比较和管理 Gene。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[rotifer-protocol/rotifer-playground](https://github.com/rotifer-protocol/rotifer-playground) - **版本号**：0.9.11（[固定提交 e6b42fdc9f2affb1c3136912376604e397f12d40](https://github.com/rotifer-protocol/rotifer-playground/tree/e6b42fdc9f2affb1c3136912376604e397f12d40)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-04（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定配置支持静态接线结论，外部 server、宿主、网络与回滚未实测。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：希望在 DSH 中发现和评估 Rotifer Gene 的开发者。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 与 [Q02](#research-q02) 把技能与 MCP 配置接入 DSH；不将外部 Gene 引擎归因于此 bundle。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) 审批、工具限制与沙箱是作者说明，配置只能证明传参，其他工具入口也需独立约束。 - **建议**：[Q06](#research-q06) 提出集中呈现候选及排名依据供人工审批，需要用户实验。 采用建议：[Q05](#research-q05) 先在隔离仓库只读核查并独立备份；未经授权或来源不可审时停止。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 与 [Q02](#research-q02) 把技能与 MCP 配置接入 DSH；不将外部 Gene 引擎归因于此 bundle。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) 审批、工具限制与沙箱是作者说明，配置只能证明传参，其他工具入口也需独立约束。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q06](#research-q06) 提出集中呈现候选及排名依据供人工审批，需要用户实验。 在隔离 DSH 配置中核实工具列表、外部服务拒绝、网络行为和备份恢复。 ## 场景与替代办法 希望在 DSH 中发现和评估 Rotifer Gene 的开发者。 直接使用 Rotifer CLI 及人工比较 Gene，未比较效果和成本。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖 | 作用 | 限制 | |---|---|---| | DSH skill provider 与 MCP bridge | 加载指导及桥接 | 宿主可用性未测 | | Node、npx 与固定 MCP 包 | 启动服务 | 外部代码和网络依赖 | | Rotifer API 或 Gene | 查询与执行 | 效果、隐私和成本待核 | | 步骤 | 动作 | 条件 | |---|---|---| | 准备 | 在隔离仓库固定依赖 | 核权限与网络 | | 发现 | 通过技能查看候选 | 核工具与排名来源 | | 评估 | 对比 Gene 与备份 | 人工审批 | | 恢复 | 失败时回退备份 | 快照机制未实测 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金和资源 | 人工时间 | |---|---|---| | 首次 | 网络和模型费用未知 | 配置及审核外部代码 | | 持续 | 工具 schema 和查询成本未测 | 比较候选及数据集 | | 恢复 | 存储成本未测 | 验证备份与恢复 | | 效果 | 固定配置支持 | 未确定 | |---|---|---| | DSH 接入 | 技能 provider 与 MCP 参数 | 宿主实际加载 | | Gene 选择 | 技能说明比较和批准流程 | 排名有效性和节省时间 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：核查 DSH 组件实际配置、外部依赖与升级采用条件。 ### Q01 · 谁需要这一插件，相比直接使用 Rotifer CLI 增加什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 使用 DSH 并管理 Rotifer Gene 的开发者可通过此 bundle 获得面向选型、比较、升级和回滚的技能指导及 MCP 接入。相对直接使用 Rotifer CLI，它提供宿主内技能和预配置入口；排行榜、执行和安装由外部工具承担，不能把协议或 Gene 运行时归因于本插件，也不能据此声称收益优于手工比较。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[plugins/rotifer/README.md:14-23](https://github.com/rotifer-protocol/rotifer-playground/blob/e6b42fdc9f2affb1c3136912376604e397f12d40/plugins/rotifer/README.md#L14-L23) 作者解释目标。
查看原文（10行） ```text ## What this is Most agent capabilities are written once and never measured again. Rotifer treats a capability as a **Gene** — a versioned, testable unit with a declared input/output schema, compiled to WASM, and scored by a fitness function `F(g)` in a public Arena. Because Genes are portable and comparable, an agent can do something ordinary code cannot: **find out that a better implementation of its own capability exists, and adopt it.** This plugin brings that loop into your agent. ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[plugins/rotifer/cordis.patch.yml:17-32](https://github.com/rotifer-protocol/rotifer-playground/blob/e6b42fdc9f2affb1c3136912376604e397f12d40/plugins/rotifer/cordis.patch.yml#L17-L32) 技能提供者配置。
查看原文（16行） ```text - insert: # The four Rotifer skills, from this package's own skills/ directory: the # three skill folders plus the single-file rotifer-overview card, which this # provider reads as a skill too (the other hosts read only the folders). # includeDefaultRoots: false keeps this provider to that directory alone — # it never rescans your project or user skill roots, so it cannot shadow a # skill you wrote. The skills are read-only package files; nothing watches # them for edits. - id: rotifer-skills name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem' config: providerName: rotifer includeDefaultRoots: false watch: false customSkillDirs: - !!js "process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(process.getBuiltinModule('node:module').createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('rotifer/package.json'), '..', 'skills')" ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[plugins/rotifer/cordis.patch.yml:53-63](https://github.com/rotifer-protocol/rotifer-playground/blob/e6b42fdc9f2affb1c3136912376604e397f12d40/plugins/rotifer/cordis.patch.yml#L53-L63) MCP 桥接配置。
查看原文（11行） ```text - id: rotifer-mcp name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: rotifer transport: stdio command: npx args: - '-y' - '@rotifer/mcp-server@0.19.7' - '--tools=evolve' failOnStartupError: false ```
**依据 4 · 作者声明**：[plugins/rotifer/skills/rotifer-overview.md:10-28](https://github.com/rotifer-protocol/rotifer-playground/blob/e6b42fdc9f2affb1c3136912376604e397f12d40/plugins/rotifer/skills/rotifer-overview.md#L10-L28) 独立 CLI 基线。
查看原文（19行） ````text ## Quick Start ```bash npm install -g @rotifer/playground rotifer init my-agent && cd my-agent rotifer hello --template quality-advisor ``` `rotifer init` boots the local Arena. `rotifer hello --template quality-advisor` is the fastest way to create and run a preset agent from curated templates. ## From Preset Agent to Your Own Gene ```bash rotifer hello --template quality-advisor # Run the recommended preset agent rotifer scan genes/ # Find candidate functions rotifer wrap my-function # Wrap as a Gene rotifer test my-function # Validate in WASM sandbox rotifer arena submit my-function # Submit to Arena rotifer arena list # Watch the rankings ````
#### 缺口 - 未验证真实用户或与 CLI 的任务对照 **影响**：不能量化效率与正确性 **进一步探讨**：同任务比较宿主内技能和直接 CLI。 ### Q02 · DSH bundle 实际挂载了什么？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 package.json 将 DSH bundle 指向 cordis.patch.yml；patch 插入 filesystem provider，仅指向包内 skills、关闭默认根和 watch，另插入 stdio MCP 客户端，以 npx -y 启动固定的 @rotifer/mcp-server@0.19.7 并传 --tools=evolve，failOnStartupError 为 false。这些是声明式配置；外部 server 的服务端拒绝策略、host 的启动与加载结果均未在本次验证。index.js 属于 OpenClaw 入口，枚举本地 skills，不能当作 DSH Gene 执行器。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[plugins/rotifer/package.json:37-40](https://github.com/rotifer-protocol/rotifer-playground/blob/e6b42fdc9f2affb1c3136912376604e397f12d40/plugins/rotifer/package.json#L37-L40) bundle 入口。 ```text "dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[plugins/rotifer/cordis.patch.yml:17-32](https://github.com/rotifer-protocol/rotifer-playground/blob/e6b42fdc9f2affb1c3136912376604e397f12d40/plugins/rotifer/cordis.patch.yml#L17-L32) skills provider 的配置。
查看原文（16行） ```text - insert: # The four Rotifer skills, from this package's own skills/ directory: the # three skill folders plus the single-file rotifer-overview card, which this # provider reads as a skill too (the other hosts read only the folders). # includeDefaultRoots: false keeps this provider to that directory alone — # it never rescans your project or user skill roots, so it cannot shadow a # skill you wrote. The skills are read-only package files; nothing watches # them for edits. - id: rotifer-skills name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem' config: providerName: rotifer includeDefaultRoots: false watch: false customSkillDirs: - !!js "process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(process.getBuiltinModule('node:module').createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('rotifer/package.json'), '..', 'skills')" ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[plugins/rotifer/cordis.patch.yml:53-63](https://github.com/rotifer-protocol/rotifer-playground/blob/e6b42fdc9f2affb1c3136912376604e397f12d40/plugins/rotifer/cordis.patch.yml#L53-L63) server 命令及启动错误配置。
查看原文（11行） ```text - id: rotifer-mcp name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: rotifer transport: stdio command: npx args: - '-y' - '@rotifer/mcp-server@0.19.7' - '--tools=evolve' failOnStartupError: false ```
**依据 4 · 源码核查**：[plugins/rotifer/index.js:59-82](https://github.com/rotifer-protocol/rotifer-playground/blob/e6b42fdc9f2affb1c3136912376604e397f12d40/plugins/rotifer/index.js#L59-L82) OpenClaw 枚举代码。
查看原文（24行） ```text /** * Every Skill this plugin ships. * * Two shapes live side by side under skills/: a folder with a SKILL.md, and a * bare .md file. Both are real — skills/rotifer.md is one of the latter — so * missing either would under-report what the plugin provides. */ export function getSkills() { if (!existsSync(skillsDir)) return []; const skills = []; for (const entry of readdirSync(skillsDir)) { const full = join(skillsDir, entry); if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) { const file = join(full, "SKILL.md"); if (existsSync(file)) skills.push(readSkill(file, entry)); } else if (extname(entry) === ".md") { skills.push(readSkill(full, basename(entry, ".md"))); } } return skills.filter(Boolean); } export default { getSkills }; ```
#### 缺口 - 未运行 DSH 或外部 MCP server **影响**：无法证明启动、加载和服务端权限实际生效 **进一步探讨**：隔离环境查看 provider、工具列表和启动失败行为。 ### Q03 · 升级、回滚及安全边界是否由插件保证？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 evolve skill 指示升级需用户批准，并描述项目 genes 目录及单份快照：下一次覆盖替换旧快照，回滚会消耗该快照。README 声称 evolve 工具集只暴露 10 工具与 4 资源、不含发布和登录，并拒绝逃逸选项；patch 只能证明传入参数，无法单凭技能文本证明远程 MCP 的服务端强制、审批或沙箱安全。技能还包含 CLI 例子，其中部分操作超出 MCP 工具集；若 agent 可调用其他 shell 或工具，MCP 参数不能约束那些入口。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[plugins/rotifer/skills/evolve/SKILL.md:47-59](https://github.com/rotifer-protocol/rotifer-playground/blob/e6b42fdc9f2affb1c3136912376604e397f12d40/plugins/rotifer/skills/evolve/SKILL.md#L47-L59) 审批和快照规则为技能指令。
查看原文（13行） ````text ### Upgrade a Capability ```bash /evolve upgrade ``` Finds the top-ranked alternative in the same domain, shows you the swap, and installs it **only after you approve**. This is the one command that changes what is installed: it replaces a Gene in the project's `genes/` directory with third-party code from the marketplace, which changes what your Agent does at runtime. Genes are project files, not global ones. Install into the project the user is in, and say which directory the Gene is going into when you propose the swap. > **An overwrite is undoable.** Replacing a Gene moves the old copy into > `/.snapshots/` first. Tell the user the two ways back: `rollback_gene` > here, or `rotifer rollback ` in a terminal. One snapshot per Gene — the > next overwrite supersedes it and a rollback consumes it, so this undoes the > last upgrade rather than a history. ````
**依据 2 · 作者声明**：[plugins/rotifer/skills/evolve/SKILL.md:14-30](https://github.com/rotifer-protocol/rotifer-playground/blob/e6b42fdc9f2affb1c3136912376604e397f12d40/plugins/rotifer/skills/evolve/SKILL.md#L14-L30) 工具限制为作者声明。
查看原文（17行） ````text This plugin declares the Rotifer MCP server for you: ```bash npx -y @rotifer/mcp-server@0.19.7 --tools=evolve ``` `--tools=evolve` is not decoration. Left undeclared, the server offers 31 tools and 7 resources, `publish_gene`, `login` and `arena_submit` among them. Declared, it offers **10 tools and 4 resources**. The rest are not listed and are refused if called, so nothing here can publish on your behalf or log you in. Resources travel with the tools they duplicate — `rotifer://developers/{name}` returns what `get_developer_profile` returns, so it goes when that tool goes. A restriction with an unlisted way around it is not a restriction. The launch line also omits `--allow`, so the sandbox escapes (`no_sandbox`, `trust_unsigned`) are refused. ````
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[plugins/rotifer/cordis.patch.yml:53-63](https://github.com/rotifer-protocol/rotifer-playground/blob/e6b42fdc9f2affb1c3136912376604e397f12d40/plugins/rotifer/cordis.patch.yml#L53-L63) 仅声明启动参数。
查看原文（11行） ```text - id: rotifer-mcp name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: rotifer transport: stdio command: npx args: - '-y' - '@rotifer/mcp-server@0.19.7' - '--tools=evolve' failOnStartupError: false ```

查看原文（11行） ````text ## How it Works Under the hood, Rotifer uses **Genes** — atomic, transferable AI capabilities that compete in an **Arena**. The fittest Genes (measured by the fitness function **F(g)**) rise to the top of the rankings automatically. Ranking is the automatic part; putting a Gene on your machine is not. ```text F(g) = S_r · log₂(1 + C_util) · (1 + R_rob)/2 · L_score · Cost_score ``` Each of the five factors lies in [0, 1], so F(g) does too: a perfect score is 1. No voting, no human preference — pure runtime performance metrics determine which capabilities win. ````
